title: Additive Manufacturing Preparation Tool — Overview and definition
t: Additive Manufacturing Preparation Tool — Overview and definition
description: Orients, supports, nests, and slices models for reliable 3D printing.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Orients, supports, nests, and slices models for reliable 3D printing. An additive manufacturing preparation tool imports mesh models, repairs them, chooses build orientation, generates supports, nests parts on the platform, and previews the print layer by layer. Real implementations include PrusaSlicer, Cura, Bambu Studio, and Materialise Magics. It estimates print time and material use and validates wall thickness and overhangs against the process.
capabilities: Automatic and manual mesh repair (holes, non-manifold edges)
Orientation optimization for strength, surface quality, and support volume
Support generation: tree, organic, soluble-interface styles
Multi-part nesting and sequential printing checks
Layer preview with time and material estimates
